title: Cowboys place RB Tyler Goodson on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys place RB Tyler Goodson on injured reserve
sources.description: The Cowboys said this week that running back Tyler Goodson will miss multiple weeks due to knee and ankle injuries and we learned on Saturday that he'll be out for at least the next four games.
